'''Khreenk's Smithy''' was a business operating in the town of [[Bartyn's Landing]], in the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It sold harpoons, knives and traps. The business was owned by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Khreenk]], who had several apprentices whose worked he personally supervised in important orders.
